primary_source_receipts.claim: Einstein 'eighth wonder of the world' compound interest attribution
primary_source_receipts.finding: No evidence Einstein said it; earliest close match an unattributed 1925 advertisement; The Ultimate Quotable Einstein lists it under 'Probably Not By Einstein'. Research dated 2011, available before publication.

primary_source_receipts.claim: Index funds beat stock pickers 'every single time'
primary_source_receipts.finding: 65% of active large-cap funds underperformed the S&P 500 in 2024; no U.S. equity category had a majority of active managers outperform over 15 years. ~89.5% large-cap 15-year underperformance appears only in secondary coverage (ritholtz.com), UNVERIFIED against PDF. Released 2025, before publication. Measures funds, not individual investors; does not support 'every single time'.

primary_source_receipts.claim: Late starters panic and sell at the worst time
primary_source_receipts.finding: Secondary coverage reports ~1.2 percentage-point annual investor return gap (fund 8.2% vs investor 7.0%, decade to 2024) due to timing of flows. Supports poor timing in general; no evidence reviewed that late starters specifically panic more. UNVERIFIED as stated in video.

calculation_receipts.method: End-of-month $500 contributions at 7%/12 monthly compounding for contribution series; annual 7% compounding for single-lump traces; analyst convention, narrator states only '7% returns'
